summary: US-Iran negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz have reached a critical phase with a reported Tuesday deadline for a deal or potential airstrikes, while US naval blockade operations have redirected 45 vessels and missile stocks are heavily depleted. Simultaneously, IDF forces are conducting intensive counterterrorism operations in the West Bank and southern Lebanon, including the demolition of a Hezbollah tunnel and weapons caches. An IED attack on Israeli forces in Majdal Zoun and Yemeni attacks on Saudi tankers further escalate regional tensions.
key_points: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said a deal with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz may be reached by Wednesday, while Secretary Rubio stated the final goal remains Iran's nuclear disarmament. (Source: @mamlekate/104075)
Bloomberg reported Trump gave Iran until Tuesday to reach an agreement with Oman on the Strait or face devastating airstrikes. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94061)
US naval blockade intensified: USS Boxer supporting operations; 45 commercial vessels redirected, 2 disabled, 2 boarded as of August 4. (Source: @shin_persian/8822)

Reuters and CNN report US expended most ground-to-ground missiles, half of Tomahawk cruise missiles, ~80% of THAAD and ~half of Patriot interceptors in five-month conflict with Iran. (Source: @yediotnews25/133584, @lelotsenzura/94068)

IDF Duvdevan unit arrested a PIJ operative linked to Lion's Den in Nablus; Battalion 890 with Yahalom destroyed 10 weapons-manufacturing lathes in Qabatiya. (Source: @idf_telegram/24830, @inon_yttach/9808)

IDF 300th Brigade and Yahalom demolished a Hezbollah tunnel dozens of meters long in Srebbine; Kfir and 4th Brigades seized rockets, launchers, Kalashnikovs, anti-tank rockets. (Source: @almogboker78/17897, @manniefabian/58922)
IED explosion hit Israeli force in Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon, prompting evacuation to Rambam Hospital with three ambulances. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87015)
Yemeni Armed Forces claimed targeting Saudi tanker 'Wafa' in Red Sea, vowing continued attacks on Saudi tankers in northern Red Sea. (Source: @presstv/201654, @naya_foriraq/86998)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of a US-imposed deadline for Iran on the Strait of Hormuz, severe depletion of US missile inventories, and an active naval blockade creates a high probability of kinetic escalation in the Gulf. Simultaneous IDF operations in the West Bank and southern Lebanon indicate a sustained high-tempo counterterrorism campaign, while the IED attack in Majdal Zoun demonstrates Hezbollah's retained capability to strike Israeli forces. Yemeni attacks on Saudi shipping expand the maritime threat arena, risking further disruption of energy flows.
